# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want the issue templates fixed and the foundation Stories audited against real code and tests, so that the rest of the backlog audit runs against a proven standard

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** the issue templates fixed and the seven foundation stories audited against the code and against tests
**So that** the remaining batches run against a standard that has already been applied

## Parent Epic
Parent: #251

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [ ] Given the four issue templates, when a new issue is opened from any of
      them, then each acceptance criterion must name the test or command
      that proves it, and no template asks for a sprint field that GitHub's
      milestone already holds
- [ ] Given stories #83 to #89 with their tasks, and epics #1, #10, #15 and
      #22 above them, when each is read, then it matches its template and
      holds at most 5 acceptance criteria where the template has them
- [ ] Given a criterion with no test, when the audit reaches it, then a test
      exists, runs in CI, and was observed failing before it passed, or the
      criterion is marked `(manual: ...)` or `(no test)` with the reason
- [ ] Given any claim about a file, class or configuration value, when it is
      checked against the current repo, then it is correct, or rescoped in
      one line naming what replaced it
- [ ] Given every issue in this batch, when its metadata is read, then it
      carries one type label and one priority label, no `sprint-N` label,
      and parent/child linkage that agrees between the markdown and GitHub's
      native sub-issue link

## Notes
#253 lands before the audit tasks start, so they apply a fixed standard.

#262 runs last. An epic's child-stories list is only correct once its
stories are audited, and one task covers all four epics because #15 and #22
each parent more than one story in this batch.

The `## Sprint` section above duplicates GitHub's milestone field. It stays
until #253 removes it from the story template, so this story still matches
the template it was opened from.

Sprint 8 closes 2026-09-03. Tasks #255 to #262 will carry into Sprint 9.
